subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers flows into India from Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Ghaghara River:-**

 
 
• It is also known as the **Karnali River **in **Nepal **and the **Mapcha **Tsangpo in **Tibet** is a perennial river that flows across international borders.
 
• It **rises **on the **Tibetan Plateau's **northern Himalayan slopes, passes through Nepal's Himalayas, and then **merges** with the **Sharda **River at **Brahmaghat **in **India**.
 
• Together, they make up the **Ghaghara River**, a significant **Ganges tributary **on its left bank.
 
• The **longest river **in **Nepal**, it spans 507 km (315 mi).
 
• The Ghaghara River runs through **Bihar **for **1,080 kilometers** before joining the **Ganges **near **Revelganj (670 mi).**
 
• It is the **second-biggest tributary** of the Ganges in terms of length after the **Yamuna **and the largest by volume.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **B****hilangana:**

 
 
• ​The main tributary of the Bhagirathi River, the mother stream of the Ganges River in India, the Bhilangna River is a Himalayan river in **Uttarakhand**, **India**.
 
• **Bhil **and **Ganga** are combined to become **Bhilangana**.
 
 
 
• **Dhauliganga:**
 
 
• ​A tumultuous Himalayan river, the **Dhauliganga **rises in the **borderlands **of **India **and **China **before flowing into the **Garhwal district **of **Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• It **merges **with the **Alaknanda**, the Ganges river's principal source stream.
 
 
 
• **Son:**
 
 
• **Central India **is home to the perennial **Son **River.
 
• It starts near **Amarkantak Hill **in the **Chhattisgarh** district of **Gaurela**-**Pendra**-**Marwahi**, and eventually, it joins the **Ganges **River close to Patna, **Bihar**.
